criteria.requirement: State list and drifted use service-state Nostr records by default; drifted means drift_status exactly drifted.
Policy list and get use policy-registry Nostr records by default and report absent IDs.
Table and JSON output match REST for public state and policy fields; explicit --http-fallback calls REST.
Cursor is reused and stale local reads warn with successful exit.
Producer state and policy records decode; tampered events cannot enter the local store.
